user.title: Connect Mealie Discover
user.description: Enter the Mealie URL reachable from Home Assistant, an API token, and at least one of: a SearXNG instance with JSON output enabled, a YouTube Data API key, or a Social to Mealie add-on URL (imports YouTube videos and links from Instagram, TikTok and Facebook). Found add-ons: {detected}. Create the Mealie API token in Mealie under your profile → API Tokens.
